what.heading: What it is
what.body: TheOdooAgent is an AI agent that connects to your Odoo and lets you query and operate in natural language — without knowing how to use Odoo, without navigating menus. You ask the way you'd talk to a colleague and get real data, charts and exports.

how.heading: How it works
how.intro: You ask and it answers with your real data. Examples:
how.example2: Sales by salesperson last month, as a chart
how.example3: Create a contact: María López, maria@acme.com
how.operates: It also operates: create contacts, confirm orders, update records — always with your confirmation. It never acts on its own.

trust.heading: Why you can trust it
trust.item1: Human confirmation on every write: the agent proposes, you approve.
trust.item2: It doesn't hallucinate numbers: the system computes them, the model only writes them up.
trust.item3: It respects your Odoo permissions: it sees the same as you would.

different.heading: Why it's different
different.item1: Works on every Odoo version (14–20) and Community — Odoo's native AI requires Enterprise 18/19+.
different.item2: Deterministic architecture (Python-first): that's why the cost is rock-bottom.

partner.heading: Are you an Odoo implementer?
partner.body: You can offer it to your clients under your own brand and resell it: white-label, multi-client, from ~$1/user.

founder.heading: Made by me
founder.body: I'm Martin. I built TheOdooAgent on my own, with a simple idea: that anyone in a company could talk to their Odoo without fighting with menus. There's no company with a sales team behind this — it's the idea, the code, and me. If you try it and something doesn't work, write me: your feedback literally makes it better.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes: human confirmation, respects permissions, encrypted credentials.
faq.q3: Does it install anything in my Odoo?
faq.a3: No. It connects via a standard API key (XML-RPC).
faq.a4: Free on your own Odoo. When you deploy it to your clients, from ~$1/user.
